- Finish and validate the existing APEX GP motorcycle racing game as a complete, playable game.

- Apply requested game changes immediately without clarification; make reasonable assumptions and note them when finished.
- Validate visually with small JPEG screenshots at viewport widths of at most 1280px; read only the latest screenshot, using full-size PNGs only for fine detail.

- Inspected `index.html`, `src/main.js`, `src/track.js`, startup/capture scripts, vendored Three.js files, and repository structure.
- Confirmed the game includes menu, showroom, championship progression, three rounds, motorcycle assets, race HUD, controls, pause/restart, results, standings, persistence, keyboard/touch controls, and `window.APEX` smoke-test hooks.

- Resolve the vendored Three.js bare-import compatibility issue.
- Validate browser console/runtime behavior and exercise menu, race start/countdown, controls, pause, finish/results, and championship progression.

5. Capture the latest small JPEG at a viewport no wider than 1280px and inspect it.
